meta.name: quantum
meta.description: Quantum computing POC standards for QAE, QAOA, and hybrid quantum-classical algorithms. Use for quantum circuit design, simulator benchmarking, and honest reporting of quantum results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证量子算法在模拟器上的表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在做量子计算的概念验证，需要验证算法与电路方案。
copy.tagline_en: Validate quantum algorithm performance on simulators.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you validate quantum algorithms or circuits and need clear benchmarks.

howto.what: Claude 会按“仅模拟器”的诚实标准生成量子计算报告:用经典 CPU 模拟 QAE、QAOA 等算法,明确标注没有量子优势、规模小(3 资产、16 量子比特)、无噪声,并输出 JSON 报告。
howto.when: 当你要求设计量子电路、做模拟器基准测试,或报告 QAE、QAOA 等量子计算结果时触发。

say.text: 用 QAE 估算尾部概率 P(return ≤ -VaR),与经典蒙特卡洛对比。
say.note: 生成 QAE vs 经典对比 JSON。

say.text: 用 QAOA 做 4 资产组合优化,展示 QUBO 编码。
say.note: QAOA 为探索性 POC,不在 UI 中。

say.text: 在 AerSimulator 上跑 QAE 基准,记录运行时间和电路深度。

howto.what_en: Claude will simulate QAE, QAOA, etc. on classical CPU (AerSimulator) and label every result as simulator-only, no quantum advantage, small scale, no noise; outputs JSON reports.
howto.when_en: When you ask for quantum circuit design, simulator benchmarking, or honest reporting of QAE/QAOA/hybrid quantum-classical results.

say_en.text: Run QAE to estimate P(return ≤ -VaR) and compare with classical Monte Carlo.
say_en.note: Generates QAE vs classical comparison JSON.

say_en.text: Use QAOA for a 4-asset portfolio optimization and show the QUBO encoding.
say_en.note: QAOA is an exploratory POC not in UI.

say_en.text: Run the QAE benchmark on AerSimulator and report runtime and circuit depth.
